objective: K23 fix F3 completion: (1) oracle labeler gains a third stop geometry, sweep_extreme (trailing N-bar extreme -/+ sl_atr_buffer*atr, N = backtest.htf_candles_per_range), opt-in via label_corpus(sweep_lookback=...), so the table and the spine measure the same trade object (F-088 class); (2) reference_level becomes a per-run stamp that follows backtest.sl_anchor (a hardcoded 'displacement_extreme' would have mislabelled every sweep_extreme trade); (3) sl_anchor is stamped into BacktestMetrics/summary.json; (4) engine-vs-oracle stop parity test with a proxy-boundary negative control.
change_class_rationale: backtest_v2.TradeJournal now derives the stamped reference_level from the engine's sl_anchor (default 'displacement' -> unchanged 'displacement_extreme'); BacktestMetrics/summary gain one additive key. Labeler change is research-only and opt-in (sweep_lookback=None reproduces the legacy 8-unit-per-bar output byte-identically; asserted by test). governance.measurement_basis.REFERENCE_LEVELS gains one vocabulary member. No feature math, model, ontology formula or production config edit.

unknowns.item: Oracle sweep_extreme arm is a trailing-window PROXY, not the engine's sweep candle. Exact engine parity is proven only where the engine's sweep candle IS the window extreme; where it is not, the two stops differ (pinned by the negative-control test). How often the two coincide on real XAUUSD sweep entries is UNMEASURED.
unknowns.why_non_blocking: Robustness arm, not PRIMARY_ARM; declared in the labeler manifest caveats; no economic claim rests on it.

unknowns.item: No shadow config carries sl_anchor='sweep_extreme'; the flag is OFF in every config. Spine-vs-table equality on a real run is therefore UNMEASURED.
unknowns.why_non_blocking: Shadow config is the next step (design doc 9.3), separately authorized.

rollback_boundary: Revert the per-run reference_level plumbing (TradeJournal.sl_anchor/reference_level, SL_ANCHOR_REFERENCE_LEVEL, the sl_anchor metrics field), the labeler sweep_extreme arm + main() lookback read, REF_LEVEL_SWEEP_EXTREME, and the new/edited tests. With defaults the behaviour is the pre-change behaviour.
authority_granted: User 2026-09-24: K23 fix-first, F3 = swept extreme + 0.2 ATR, oracle must use the same geometry; oracle anchor = trailing N-bar extreme (decided in-session 2026-09-24).
authority_NOT_granted: No shadow config created, no ACTIVE_VERSION change, no promotion, no G001, no claim the anchor improves anything (F-081/F-086 nulls stand).
